note: Which generic stub map each sector loads on the stub data version. Sector names follow the map file names (A9, D13_b1 for a level below, B15_a for an alternate map). Every listed sector becomes an alias of its kind's map in the stub pack's aliases.json; a sector with its own hand-made map loads that map; every other sector loads the fallback. Original maps always win. Kinds are game design for the stub campaign, not a description of the original maps.

handMade.A10: Omerta, the rebels' town with the dealers of the shop tests
handMade.P3_b1: the palace basement, the Queen's last room

kinds.note: town sectors: militia training, a dealer's shop, civilians, a garrison of up to 20
the town map's jail block holds the captives of a lost battle in its cells
mine entrances: the head miner's office and a shaft down to the level below
mine levels: tunnels with miners and creature slots, a ladder up to the surface above
creature lairs: the cave's creature slots and the creature queen's slot
the other levels below the surface (Tixa's dungeon, Orta's cellar, the statue tunnel)
SAM sites: a launcher inside a ring of barricades
sectors with a standing garrison outside the towns (the roads to Meduna, the roadblocks)
the palace: the hand-made map of the Queen's hall with the stairs down to P3_b1
Drassen airport: the helipad where Skyrider's helicopter is set up
the alternate maps of the sectors where Skyrider may start
